message: You know those moments when you feel like you’ve been preparing for something forever, and then it finally happens? Yep, I had a little ‘I told you so’ moment when the lights went out last week. I found this handy guide that covers all the bases for power outages—everything from keeping food safe to staying comfortable. It’s a gentle reminder that a little prep can go a long way. Have you given your blackout plan a thought lately?
